As Alrn warns in the Gemstones album's info, it's an awful lot of work to get this item. Sure, it looks nice and all, but here are two alternatives to consider:

Seeker Coat gives +2 Search
Cold Resistant Fur Clothes gives +2 Collection and +2 Procurement

Full details on their respective pages. Cheers.
